tools.name: sm_list_projects
tools.description: Resolve which Space Monkey projects this API key can read. Call this first when the user names a company rather than a project ID, and match on companyName — never silently mix projects.

tools.name: sm_get_account
tools.description: Introspect the API key's own account — effective tier, per-service entitlements, current hour/month quota usage and project count. Use it to check headroom or diagnose a 403/429 before retrying.

tools.name: sm_list_leaders
tools.description: Rank the most engaged members of a project by engagement percentile. Use when you need who is paying attention right now, filtered by rep, tag, rating, status or bot/insider rules.

tools.name: sm_list_at_risk
tools.description: Find previously engaged members whose recent activity has collapsed, for building save lists. Note its engagementScore is a raw decayed score that can be negative, unlike the leaders percentile.

tools.name: sm_list_members
tools.description: Browse or search a project's full member directory. Use when you need people by rating, tag, status or free-text search rather than by engagement rank.

tools.name: sm_get_member
tools.description: Load one member's full profile — title, company, tags, clicked URLs, engagement percentile, at-risk state and bot detection. Use for pre-call briefs and to enrich a shortlist.

tools.name: sm_get_member_campaigns
tools.description: List the individual campaigns one member received, opened or clicked. This email-level drill-down is often empty even for highly engaged members, so always keep a fallback.

tools.name: sm_get_member_timeline
tools.description: Replay one member's raw activity events in time order. Use to establish when someone last paid attention and what triggered it.

tools.name: sm_list_campaigns
tools.description: List a project's campaigns with performance metrics. Use to map a member's lastActivityAt onto a real send, or to find the latest house send by send_time.

tools.name: sm_get_campaign
tools.description: Load one campaign's full report — funnel, click-to-open, geography and metadata. Use after you have identified a campaign of interest.

tools.name: sm_get_variate
tools.description: Analyse a variate (A/B) campaign — per-variant reports, statistical significance, engagement velocity, audience quality and geo split. Only meaningful for multivariate campaigns.

tools.name: sm_get_insights_basic
tools.description: Get headline campaign and audience performance for a project, including period-over-period averages and trends. Start here for "how are we doing".

tools.name: sm_get_insights_advanced
tools.description: Get deeper audience analytics — engagement distribution, tag and segment summaries, growth baselines and campaign consistency. Use when basic insights cannot explain a change.

tools.name: sm_get_insights_expert
tools.description: Get expert diagnostics — campaign fatigue, subject-line keywords, send-time heatmap, monthly trend and audience health. Use to explain why performance is moving.

tools.name: sm_get_member_overview
tools.description: Get aggregate audience composition for a project — totals plus status, rating, rep and language breakdowns. Use for a quick shape-of-the-list answer.

tools.name: sm_get_member_growth
tools.description: Get signup cohorts, churn timeline and cohort retention. Use for list-growth and attrition questions.

tools.name: sm_get_member_segments
tools.description: Get tags and segments with their engagement and status breakdowns. Use to turn an event or interest tag into a working audience.

tools.name: sm_get_member_geo
tools.description: Get the country and region distribution of a project's members. Use for territory, event and travel-planning questions.

tools.name: sm_list_sync_runs
tools.description: List recent data-pipeline sync runs with status and results. Operational tool for checking data freshness before trusting an analysis.

tools.name: sm_get_sync_run
tools.description: Load one sync run's full detail — per-stage results, progress, lookback window and pending batch count. Use after sm_list_sync_runs to explain why data is stale or a run failed.

tools.name: sm_get_knowledge
tools.description: Returns Space Monkey's MCP knowledge documents (analyst preamble, metric guardrails, live OpenAPI schema URL) as tool output for clients that cannot read MCP resources — read this before interpreting any Space Monkey metrics.

tools.name: sm_get_schema
tools.description: Get the Enterprise API's OpenAPI-derived schema catalog. Omitting `operation` returns a compact index of every Enterprise API operation; passing a tool name, full path, or path suffix returns that one operation's full parameters and resolved response schemas. findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "sm_list_projects" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Resolve which Space Monkey projects this API key can read. Call this first when the user names a company rather than a project ID, and match on companyName — ne…

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "sm_get_schema" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Get the Enterprise API's OpenAPI-derived schema catalog. Omitting `operation` returns a compact index of every Enterprise API operation; passing a tool name, fu…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sm_get_member, sm_get_member_campaigns, sm_get_knowledge · Private data: sm_list_projects, sm_get_account, sm_get_knowledge, sm_get_prompt · Public sink: sm_get_member_campaigns, sm_list_campaigns, sm_get_insights_expert, sm_list_prompts · Destructive: sm_get_sync_run, sm_list_prompts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sm_get_member, sm_get_member_campaigns, sm_get_knowledge · Private data: sm_list_projects, sm_get_account, sm_get_knowledge, sm_get_prompt · Public sink: sm_get_member_campaigns, sm_list_campaigns, sm_get_insights_expert, sm_list_prompts · Destructive: sm_get_sync_run, sm_list_prompts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
